title: dactylorhiza viridis var. virescens
intro: Dactylorhiza viridis var. virescens, commonly known as Western Marsh Orchid, is a variety of orchid native to Europe and western Asia. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antibacterial effects, which may help alleviate respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Dactylorhiza viridis var. virescens include expectorant and mucolytic effects, helping to loosen and clear mucus from the airways. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
